_comment: The short list of skills a learner sees when they open n8n.
n8n only draws folders inside a project, never on the Overview page, so these
folders live in the local owner's Personal project and the launcher prints the
Personal project link as the place to start.
Every file in n8n/workflows must appear in exactly one folder. A workflow can
only live in one folder, so a plumbing workflow shared by two capabilities
(40-confirm-task-write) sits with the skill it belongs to most.
Folder IDs are fixed so re-running setup updates the same folders instead
of creating duplicates. Order controls both the number in the name and the
timestamps, so the list reads top to bottom under either n8n sort option.
Names are what a learner reads. Say the skill out loud; no node names, no IDs.
Workflow numbering: the 50-69 tool band and 70-79 trigger band are full, and
the scheduler skill has spilled into 76-80. From 100 upward the convention is
one contiguous ten-number block per skill, so a skill's files read together in
a directory listing. 100-109 is the Xero coding review; 90 stays the debug
workflow; the skill after that takes 110-119.

folders.name: 1. Start here
folders.description: The two workflows a learner opens first: the agent itself, and the checklist that walks them through setup.

folders.name: 2. Tasks
folders.description: Everything the agent can do with the tasks saved on your computer: read them, propose a change, confirm it, and write it.

folders.name: 3. Your business
folders.description: Researching a website you own and recalling what the agent already learned about the business.

folders.name: 4. Asana
folders.description: Your own Asana integration: look up projects and people, then create tasks from a reviewed meeting.

folders.name: 4. Finding customers
folders.description: Matching one named person to a likely public professional profile after the user explicitly requests a paid lookup.

folders.name: 5. Setup and health
folders.description: Run-once plumbing and the health check. A learner rarely opens these, but they should be able to find them.

folders.name: 5. Ways your agent gets started
folders.description: Entry points that let something outside your computer start your agent: a Telegram message today, an inbox or a schedule later.
